note: The values the agent copies into a batch from a span, the provider, model, region and prompt version, are identifiers, not text. A value that does not look like one (wrong characters, too long) or that looks like a credential is replaced by "invalid" before aggregation, so a prompt, personal data or a key put in the wrong attribute never reaches a batch (D-065). The pattern is the one tellproof.policy.json uses for declared models, so every value a batch can carry can be declared. Both the agent (internal/otlp) and the concierge (concierge/ingest.py) apply this file; spec/leak-corpus.json holds the examples both must classify the same way.
